point: 本文是第一篇系统研究常规正则化方法在策略优化算法（连续控制）上效果的工作。
quote_en: To our best knowledge, we provide the first systematic study of common regularization methods in policy optimization, which have been largely ignored in the deep RL literature.

point: 研究六种正则化方法：L2、L1 权重正则、权重裁剪、Dropout、Batch Normalization，以及作为对照的熵正则。
quote_en: We study six regularization methods, namely, L2 and L1 weight regularization, weight clipping, Dropout (Srivastava et al., 2014), Batch Normalization (Ioffe & Szegedy, 2015), and entropy regularization.

point: 在四个流行策略优化算法上评测：A2C、TRPO、PPO（同策略）和 SAC（异策略）。
quote_en: We evaluate regularization methods on four popular policy optimization algorithms, namely, A2C (Mnih et al., 2016), TRPO (Schulman et al., 2015), PPO (Schulman et al., 2017), and SAC (Haarnoja et al., 2018). The first three algorithms are on-policy while the last one is off-policy.

point: 在九个连续控制任务上测试，含 MuJoCo 的 Hopper/Walker/HalfCheetah/Ant/Humanoid/HumanoidStandup 与 RoboSchool 的 Humanoid/AtlasForwardWalk/HumanoidFlagrun。
quote_en: The algorithms with different regularizers are tested on nine continuous control tasks: Hopper, Walker, HalfCheetah, Ant, Humanoid, and HumanoidStandup from MuJoCo (Todorov et al., 2012); Humanoid, AtlasForwardWalk, and HumanoidFlagrun from RoboSchool (OpenAI).

point: 默认实验只对策略网络施加正则化；每个实验跑 5 个随机种子，取最后 100 个 episode 的平均回报作为最终结果。
quote_en: The results shown in this section are obtained by only regularizing the policy network, and a further study on this will be presented in Section 5. We run each experiment independently with five seeds, then use the average return over the last 100 episodes as the final result.

point: L2 正则在策略网络损失上加 (1/2)λ||θ||₂²，L1 加 λ||θ||₁，总损失用 Adam 优化。
quote_en: When applying L2 regularization, we add an additional L2-norm squared loss term 1/2 λ||θ||₂² to L, where θ are model parameters and λ is a hyperparameter. Similarly, in the case of L1 weight regularization, the additional loss term is λ||θ||₁.

point: 权重裁剪在每步梯度更新后把每个权重夹到 [−c, c]：θ_i ← max(min(θ_i, c), −c)。
quote_en: This could be formally described as θ_i ← max(min(θ_i, c), −c), where c is a hyperparameter.

point: L2 是最常改善基线的正则方法；本文称其总体上最有效。
quote_en: Perhaps the most significant observation is that L2 regularization is the most often to improve upon the baseline.

point: 按 z-score 衡量提升幅度，L2 在总体上最常居首、且优势明显（Table 2 总列 z-score=0.53）。
quote_en: L2 tops the average z-score most often, and by large margin in total; entropy regularization is best used with A2C; Dropout and BN are only useful in the off-policy SAC algorithm; the improvement over baseline is larger on hard tasks.

point: Batch Normalization 在同策略算法上总是显著伤害基线；Dropout 和 BN 只在异策略 SAC 上有时带来提升。
quote_en: We observe that BN always significantly hurts the baseline for on-policy algorithms. The reason will be discussed later. For the off-policy SAC algorithm, dropout and BN sometimes bring large improvement on hard tasks like AtlasForwardWalk and RoboschoolHumanoid.

point: 在作者的调参范围内，'伤害'比例：L2 为 0.0%、L1 为 2.8%、权重裁剪 5.6%、Dropout 44.4%、BN 66.7%、熵正则 0.0%。
quote_en: then total percentage of hurting is 0.0% for L2, 2.8% for L1, 5.6% for weight clipping, 44.4% for dropout, 66.7% for BN, and 0.0% for entropy.

point: 所有正则方法在更难的任务上更常带来提升（作者推测易任务基线本就够强）。
quote_en: All regularization methods generally improve more often when they are used on harder tasks, perhaps because for easier ones the baseline is often sufficiently strong to reach a high performance.

point: 只正则化策略网络最常带来改善；只正则化价值网络一般无益，两者都正则虽优于只正则价值网络但不如只正则策略网络。
quote_en: We observe that generally, only regularizing the policy network is the most often to improve almost all algorithms and regularizations. Regularizing the value network alone does not bring improvement as often as other options. Though regularizing both is better than regularizing value network alone, it is worse than only regularizing the policy network.

point: 在 PPO Humanoid 上：基线回报 3485±302、策略熵 −10.32、策略权重范数 30.73；L2 回报 8148±335、熵 8.11、范数 8.71；熵正则回报 3805±349、熵 4.46、范数 30.97。L2 与熵正则得到相近的最终熵，但 L2 最终性能高得多。
quote_en: Even though both the entropy-regularized model and the L2-regularized model have similar final policy entropy, L2-regularized model have much higher final performance, which suggests that simply increasing the policy entropy is not enough.

point: 数据增强（随机缩放状态）无法改善基线，却能显著改善 L2 模型：PPO Humanoid 上 L2 从 8148±335 提升到带 DA 的 9006±145。
quote_en: Interestingly, while DA cannot improve the baseline performance, it can significantly improve the performance of L2-regularized model.
where: p.8 §6 Robustness to Training Noise + 表6

point: 作者从四个角度分析正则为何能改善 RL 的泛化：样本复杂度、回报分布、权重范数、训练噪声鲁棒性。
quote_en: Finally, we discuss and analyze why regularization may help generalization in RL from four perspectives - sample complexity, return distribution, weight norm, and noise robustness.

point: 正则化模型用更少的训练样本就能达到与基线相同的回报水平，说明降低了样本复杂度（图3，10 个随机种子）。
quote_en: From the results in Figure 3, we find that for regularized models to reach the same return level as baseline, they need much fewer training samples.

point: 正则化的结论在五种随机采样的超参数设置下依然成立，主结论稳健（Table 3）。
quote_en: We note that our main findings in Section 3 still hold.

point: 改善在硬任务上多数具统计显著性（p<0.05）；总体上 L2、L1、熵和权重裁剪都统计显著优于基线。
quote_en: In total, L2, L1, entropy and weight clipping are all statistically significantly better than baseline.

point: 策略网络 Dropout 不适用于 TRPO：更新中新旧网络丢弃不同神经元会造成同一状态下新旧动作分布偏移，违反信任域约束，导致从初始化起就无法更新。
quote_en: Policy network dropout is not applicable to TRPO because during policy updates, different neurons in the old and new policy networks are dropped out, causing significant shifts in the old and new action distributions given the same state, which violates the trust region constraint. In this case, the algorithm fails to perform any update from network initialization.

point: 在 Atari（5 个随机采样环境）上 L2 仍能显著改善基线，BN 仍显著伤害同策略；与连续控制不同，熵正则在 Atari 上提升很大（可能因离散动作空间）。
quote_en: We find that L2 regularization can still significantly improve over the baseline, while L1 and weight clipping are slightly less effective. Interestingly, while BN still significantly harms performance on on-policy environments (A2C, TRPO, PPO), dropout can significantly outperform the baseline.

point: 在异策略 DDPG（5 个 MuJoCo 环境）上，Dropout 与 BN 的平均 z-score 高于基线，支持其'只在异策略上有用'的假设。
quote_en: Notably, Dropout and Batch Normalization can be useful in DDPG, as indicated by the higher average z-score than the baseline, which supports our hypothesis that they can be helpful on off-policy algorithms.

point: L2 直接加损失与 AdamW（解耦权重衰减）都能显著改善基线，但 AdamW 的性能略低于 L2。
quote_en: We find that while both L2 regularization and AdamW can significantly improve the performance over baseline, the performance of AdamW tends to be slightly lower than the performance of L2 regularization.

point: 对 BN/Dropout 只在异策略有用，作者给出两条假设：训练/测试模式不一致在同策略下造成严重'离策略'问题甚至崩溃；以及 BN 对输入分布快速变化敏感而同策略数据变化更快。
quote_en: For on-policy algorithms, if such discrepancy is large, it can cause severe “off-policy issues”, which hurts the optimization process or even crashes it since their theory necessitates that the data is “on policy”, i.e., data sampling and optimization policies are the same.
where: p.8 §6 Why do BN and dropout work only with off-policy

point: 实验算力开销很大：用了多达 16 块 NVIDIA Titan Xp GPU 和 96 个 Intel Xeon E5-2667 CPU，全部实验约耗时 57 天。
quote_en: We used up to 16 NVIDIA Titan Xp GPUs and 96 Intel Xeon E5-2667 CPUs, and all experiments take roughly 57 days with resources fully utilized.
